headline.bm: PRN Melaka: 50.43% keluar mengundi menjelang 1.38 petang, keputusan dijangka malam ini, di tengah isu tahanan rumah Najib. Iran menimbang keluar NPT ketika serangan kapal tangki Hormuz berterusan; zero-day Microsoft Outlook disenaraikan dalam KEV CISA.
headline.en: Melaka polls: 50.43% turnout by 1.38pm, results expected tonight, amid the Najib house-arrest row. Iran weighs an NPT exit as Hormuz tanker attacks continue; a Microsoft Outlook zero-day is on CISA's KEV list.

summary.bm: Peratus keluar mengundi mencecah 50.43% (337,716 pengundi) menjelang 1.38 petang berbanding sasaran SPR 70%; Serkam mendahului dengan 57.19% manakala Bandar Hilir terendah 43.16%. Pengundian ditutup 6 petang; ribut petir diramal pada waktu petang dan belum ada kerusi diumumkan.
summary.en: Turnout reached 50.43% (337,716 voters) by 1.38pm against the EC's 70% target; Serkam leads at 57.19% and Bandar Hilir trails at 43.16%. Polling closes at 6pm; thunderstorms were forecast for the afternoon and no seat has been called yet.

title.bm: Melaka mengundi hari ini: 79 calon, 28 kerusi; keputusan dijangka sebelum tengah malam
title.en: Melaka votes today: 79 candidates, 28 seats; results expected before midnight

why.bm: Keputusan menjadi ujian penting buat BN, PH dan PN menjelang PRU16; pada 2021 BN menang 21, PH 5 dan PN 2.
why.en: Result is a key test for BN, PH and PN ahead of GE16; the 2021 result was BN 21, PH 5, PN 2.

summary.bm: Al Jazeera melaporkan dua lagi kematian berkaitan campak, menjadikan jumlah 2026 sebanyak 10; CIDRAP menyatakan AS hampir kehilangan status penghapusan campak. Kiraan awal meletakkan kes melebihi 5,100 tahun ini.
summary.en: Al Jazeera reports two more measles-associated deaths, bringing the 2026 total to 10; CIDRAP says the US is poised to lose measles elimination status. Earlier tallies put cases above 5,100 this year.

title.bm: Kematian berkaitan campak di AS capai 10 selepas dua lagi dilaporkan
title.en: US measles-associated deaths reach 10 after two more reported

why.bm: Semak status vaksin MMR kanak-kanak sebelum melancong ke kawasan wabak.
why.en: Check children's MMR status before travel to outbreak areas.

summary.bm: Jabatan Penjara berkata lawatan pada Jumaat turut merangkumi pemeriksaan hospital dan kaunseling. Laporan awal menyebut Najib berada di luar kediaman Taman Duta hampir lapan jam dan pulang pada 6.27 petang.
summary.en: The Prisons Department says the outing on Friday also included a hospital check-up and counselling. Earlier reports said Najib was out of his Taman Duta residence for nearly eight hours and returned at 6.27pm.

title.bm: Jabatan Penjara: Lawatan hampir lapan jam Najib bukan sekadar solat Jumaat
title.en: Prisons Dept: Najib's near eight-hour outing was not only for Friday prayers

why.bm: Menghangatkan isu tahanan rumah ketika Melaka mengundi dan ketegangan dalam gabungan berterusan.
why.en: Keeps the house-arrest row alive as Melaka votes and the coalition tension continues.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Hydrogen tersedia dalam AI Studio, API Gemini, aplikasi Gemini dan Carian, berharga $1.50 sejuta token input dan $7.50 sejuta token output dengan konteks 1 juta token. Google mendakwa ia hampir setara Carbon pada Terminal-Bench 4.0 dengan penggunaan kuota 24% lebih rendah (angka syarikat).
summary.en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app and Search, priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens with a 1M-token context. Google says it nears Carbon on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with 24% less quota use (company figures).

title.bm: Google lancarkan Gemini 4 Hydrogen merentasi API, aplikasi dan Carian
title.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen across API, app and Search

why.bm: Peringkat Gemini yang lebih murah meningkatkan tekanan harga ke atas API AI pesaing.
why.en: A cheaper Gemini tier raises price pressure on rival AI APIs.

summary.bm: Pelanggan boleh membeli ChatGPT Enterprise melalui AWS Marketplace, dibilkan melalui akaun AWS sedia ada dan dikira dalam komitmen AWS. OpenAI berkata ciri dan masa keluaran sama seperti pelanggan langsung.
summary.en: Customers can buy ChatGPT Enterprise via AWS Marketplace, billed through existing AWS accounts and counting toward AWS commitments. OpenAI says features and release timing match direct customers.

title.bm: ChatGPT Enterprise kini dijual melalui AWS Marketplace
title.en: ChatGPT Enterprise now sold through AWS Marketplace

why.bm: Memudahkan syarikat berasaskan AWS menggunakan ChatGPT.
why.en: Makes it easier for AWS-centric firms to adopt ChatGPT.

summary.bm: Penganalisis berkata pemindahan Najib ke tahanan rumah, selepas pengampunan bersyarat sehingga 23 Ogos 2028 dengan denda RM50 juta dibayar Umno, mungkin menggerakkan penyokong sedia ada BN di Melaka tetapi sukar menarik pengundi baharu atau memberi kesan kepada PRU16. Loke menggesa pengundi menggunakan peti undi untuk menyatakan pendirian.
summary.en: Analysts say Najib's move to house arrest, after a conditional pardon valid to 23 Aug 2028 with the RM50m fine paid by Umno, may energise existing BN supporters in Melaka but is unlikely to win new voters or carry over to GE16. Loke has urged voters to use the ballot box to express their views.

title.bm: Faktor Najib kini menjadi pertimbangan ketika Melaka menuju PRN 14 Nov
title.en: Najib factor now in the mix as Melaka heads to the polls on 14 Nov

why.bm: Keputusan ini ujian penting buat BN dan PH menjelang PRU16.
why.en: The result is a key test for BN and PH ahead of GE16.

summary.bm: KLCI ditutup 1,585.96 pada 12 Nov, turun 0.57% untuk kerugian keempat berturut-turut dan paras terendah tahun ini, dengan 799 saham susut berbanding 318 naik. Ia merosot lagi pada pembukaan 13 Nov ke 1,584.91 kerana kebimbangan Nvidia; penganalisis sebut sokongan 1,575 dan 1,550.
summary.en: The KLCI closed at 1,585.96 on Nov 12, down 0.57% for a fourth straight loss and a year-to-date low, with 799 losers to 318 gainers. It slipped again at the Nov 13 open to 1,584.91 on Nvidia worries; analysts cite supports at 1,575 and 1,550.

title.bm: Bursa ditutup rendah empat hari berturut-turut: FBM KLCI 1,585.96
title.en: Bursa ends lower for a fourth straight day: FBM KLCI closes at 1,585.96

why.bm: Menandakan sentimen berhati-hati terhadap ekuiti Malaysia menjelang PRN Melaka dan semakan indeks.
why.en: Signals cautious sentiment on Malaysian equities before the Melaka polls and index rejig.

summary.bm: Brent berada pada $95.41 dan WTI $88.52 awal pagi Jumaat, turun sekitar 2.4% dan 2.5% minggu ini selepas susut 16% dan 13% minggu lalu. Stok minyak mentah AS naik 4.7 juta tong kepada 414.4 juta, manakala serangan Houthi ke atas infrastruktur Saudi dan serangan kapal tangki di Hormuz mengekalkan risiko bekalan.
summary.en: Brent was at $95.41 and WTI $88.52 early Friday, down about 2.4% and 2.5% on the week after drops of 16% and 13% the week before. US crude stocks rose 4.7 million barrels to 414.4 million, while Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and Hormuz tanker hits kept supply risk high.

title.bm: Minyak menuju penurunan mingguan kedua dekat $95 apabila Trump kekalkan sekatan Iran
title.en: Oil heads for a second weekly fall near $95 as Trump keeps the Iran blockade

why.bm: Minyak hampir $95 masih menekan harga bahan api, subsidi dan inflasi di Malaysia.
why.en: Oil near $95 still feeds fuel, subsidy and inflation pressure in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Indeks dolar sekitar 103.17 dan menuju kenaikan mingguan terbesar dalam lebih sebulan, manakala yen sempat mencecah 160 sedolar. CME FedWatch menunjukkan peluang 14.5% kenaikan 50 mata asas pada Disember, berbanding sifar seminggu lalu; hasil 10 tahun mencecah 5.1433%.
summary.en: The dollar index is about 103.17, set for its biggest weekly gain in over a month, and the yen briefly touched 160 per dollar. CME FedWatch shows a 14.5% chance of a 50bp December hike, from zero a week ago; the 10-year yield hit a three-week high of 5.1433%.

title.bm: Dolar hampir paras tertinggi 19 bulan apabila pedagang meramal kenaikan kadar Fed; hasil 10 tahun 5.14%
title.en: Dollar near 19-month high as traders price possible Fed hike; 10-year yield at 5.14%

why.bm: Dolar lebih kukuh dan hasil lebih tinggi menekan ringgit dan Bursa serta menaikkan kos import.
why.en: A stronger dollar and higher yields weigh on the ringgit and Bursa and raise import costs.

summary.bm: CIDRAP melaporkan kes di DR Congo melebihi 11,000 (kiraan awal mencatat 5,376 kematian), manakala Kenya memulakan kiraan bebas Ebola. Nigeria menamatkan pemantauan 21 hari terhadap 62 kontak tanpa penularan sekunder.
summary.en: CIDRAP reports DR Congo cases above 11,000 (an earlier tally had 5,376 deaths), while Kenya has begun its Ebola-free countdown. Nigeria ended 21-day monitoring of 62 contacts with no secondary transmission.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC lebihi 11,000 kes; Kenya mula kiraan bebas Ebola, Nigeria tamat pemantauan
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo): DRC tops 11,000 cases; Kenya starts Ebola-free countdown, Nigeria ends monitoring

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke Afrika Tengah/Timur perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan, elak kontak dengan orang sakit dan lapor demam selepas pulang. WHO menasihatkan agar tiada sekatan perjalanan atau perdagangan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to Central/East Africa should follow health advisories, avoid contact with sick people and report fever after return. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

summary.bm: Trump menulis di Truth Social bahawa AS tidak memerlukan perjanjian dengan Iran dan mengawal Hormuz serta wang Iran, sekali gus menghentikan diplomasi Naib Presiden Vance. Tentera Iran berkata empat kapal tangki terkena letupan Khamis; sekurang-kurangnya 10 kapal diserang dalam 10 hari pertama November selepas 37 serangan pada Oktober.
summary.en: Trump wrote on Truth Social that Washington does not need a deal with Iran and controls Hormuz and Iran's money, effectively halting VP Vance's Iran diplomacy. Iran's military says four tankers were hit by explosions on Thursday; at least 10 ships were hit in the first 10 days of November after 37 attacks in October.

title.bm: Trump: AS 'tidak perlukan perjanjian' dengan Iran ketika serangan kapal di Hormuz berterusan
title.en: Trump says US 'doesn't need a deal' with Iran as Hormuz ship attacks continue

why.bm: Meningkatkan kebarangkalian gangguan Hormuz berpanjangan, mengekalkan tekanan harga minyak, kos penghantaran dan subsidi bahan api Malaysia.
why.en: Raises the odds of a long Hormuz disruption, keeping oil, shipping costs and Malaysian fuel/subsidy pressure elevated.

summary.bm: Pengawal Revolusi Iran berkata dua kapal tangki super yang membawa lebih 4 juta tong gabungan sedang terbakar, manakala tentera berkata dua kapal tangki lain terkena periuk api laut di timur selat itu. Tehran juga menolak pemindahan 60% uranium diperkaya ke negara ketiga.
summary.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two supertankers carrying over 4 million barrels combined are ablaze, while the army says two other tankers hit a naval mine east of the strait. Tehran also rejected transferring 60% of its enriched uranium to a third country.

title.bm: Iran: empat kapal tangki terkena serangan di Hormuz, dua kapal tangki super terbakar selepas 'letupan kuat'
title.en: Iran says four tankers hit in Hormuz, two supertankers ablaze after 'violent explosion'

why.bm: Serangan terhadap perkapalan mengekalkan turun naik minyak dan risiko harga bahan api buat Malaysia.
why.en: Shipping attacks keep oil volatile and fuel-price risk elevated for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Penyerang mengeksploitasi kelemahan N-central beberapa jam selepas PoC diterbitkan, menjangkiti sekurang-kurangnya 21 pelayan (19 pada hotfix terkini) dan memasang pelombong kripto. N-able mematikan Legacy API secara lalai dan integrasi Intune pada persekitaran dihoskan.
summary.en: Attackers exploited N-central flaws within hours of a PoC release, infecting at least 21 servers (19 on the latest hotfix) and deploying crypto miners. N-able has disabled the Legacy API by default and Intune integration in hosted environments.

title.bm: Kelemahan sifar-hari N-able N-central 'Able2Shell' dieksploitasi selepas PoC diterbitkan
title.en: N-able N-central 'Able2Shell' zero-days exploited after researcher publishes PoC

why.bm: Jika anda menggunakan N-central (biasa pada MSP dan pasukan IT), pasang HF2 segera dan semak pendedahan.
why.en: If you run N-central (common with MSPs and IT teams), apply HF2 now and review exposure.

summary.bm: Pihak berkuasa Iran berkata sebuah kapal tangki yang membawa LNG terkena periuk api dan mengalami letupan di Hormuz, menambah laporan sebelum ini mengenai empat kapal tangki dilanggar. Butiran kerosakan dan mangsa masih diperoleh.
summary.en: Iranian authorities say a tanker carrying LNG struck a mine and suffered an explosion in Hormuz, adding to earlier reports of four tankers hit. Details of damage and casualties were still emerging.

title.bm: Iran berkata kapal tangki LNG terkena periuk api dan meletup di Selat Hormuz
title.en: Iran says an LNG tanker hit a mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz

why.bm: Risiko baharu terhadap aliran LNG dan minyak mengekalkan harga tenaga tinggi dan kebimbangan kos bahan api di Malaysia.
why.en: Fresh risk to LNG and oil flows keeps energy prices and Malaysian fuel-cost concerns elevated.

summary.bm: Outlook, Teams dan Copilot terganggu beberapa jam dengan kira-kira 200,000 laporan Downdetector; perkhidmatan beransur pulih lewat 13 Nov.
summary.en: Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down for hours with about 200,000 Downdetector reports; services were recovering later on Nov 13.

title.bm: Gangguan global Microsoft menyebabkan jutaan pengguna hilang akses Outlook, Teams dan alat lain
title.en: Global Microsoft outage leaves millions without Outlook, Teams and other tools

why.bm: Perniagaan yang bergantung pada Microsoft 365 patut mempunyai saluran sandaran ketika gangguan.
why.en: Businesses relying on Microsoft 365 should have a fallback channel for outages.

summary.bm: Setakat 8 pagi 13 Nov, mangsa banjir Selangor meningkat kepada 1,248 (338 keluarga) daripada 1,144 malam tadi, manakala Hilir Perak turun kepada 288 (83 keluarga). Sungai Kurau di Bukit Merah pada paras amaran 9.14 m dan ribut diramal petang ini.
summary.en: As of 8am on Nov 13, Selangor evacuees rose to 1,248 (338 families) from 1,144 the previous evening, while Hilir Perak fell to 288 (83 families). Sungai Kurau at Bukit Merah is at a warning level of 9.14 m and storms are forecast this afternoon.

title.bm: Mangsa banjir Selangor meningkat kepada 1,248 di tujuh PPS; Perak reda kepada 288
title.en: Selangor flood evacuees rise to 1,248 in seven relief centres; Perak eases to 288

why.bm: Penduduk di kawasan terjejas Selangor perlu mengikut arahan pemindahan.
why.en: Residents in affected Selangor areas should follow evacuation notices.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi berkata Perdana Menteri bimbang tentang protokol keselamatan anggota polis susulan serangan di Kepong. Butiran lanjut terdapat dalam laporan Malay Mail.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi says the Prime Minister is concerned about safety protocols for police officers following the Kepong attack. Further details were in the Malay Mail report.

title.bm: Anwar bimbang protokol keselamatan polis selepas serangan di Kepong
title.en: Anwar concerned over police safety protocols after Kepong attack

why.bm: Berkait keselamatan anggota barisan hadapan dan ketenteraman awam.
why.en: Touches on frontline police safety and public order.

summary.bm: Mayat seorang warga India ditemui pada 3.40 petang 13 Nov, mangsa ketujuh limpahan air di Hulu Selangor. Seorang daripada lapan yang dilaporkan hilang masih belum ditemui.
summary.en: The body of an Indian national was found at 3.40pm on 13 Nov, the seventh victim of the water surge in Hulu Selangor. One of the eight reported missing is still unaccounted for.

title.bm: Limpahan Sungai Pertak: mangsa ketujuh ditemui, seorang masih hilang
title.en: Sungai Pertak surge: seventh victim found, one still missing

why.bm: Jauhi sungai dan kawasan rekreasi ketika hujan lebat.
why.en: Stay away from rivers and recreation areas during heavy rain.

summary.bm: Mahkamah menetapkan 20 Jan 2027 untuk keputusan perbicaraan tuntutan palsu RM1.18 juta bekas Menteri Besar Perlis itu.
summary.en: The court set Jan 20, 2027 for its decision in the former Perlis menteri besar's RM1.18 million false-claims trial.

title.bm: Perbicaraan tuntutan palsu RM1.18 juta bekas MB Perlis Azlan Man: keputusan 20 Jan 2027
title.en: Ex-Perlis MB Azlan Man's RM1.18m false-claims trial: decision on Jan 20, 2027

why.bm: Kes berkaitan rasuah yang menjadi perhatian negara menghampiri keputusan.
why.en: A national-interest corruption-related case moves toward a verdict.

summary.bm: Pihak berkuasa berkata fasa kedua program pendaftaran pelarian akan bermula tidak lama lagi. FMT melaporkannya pada 13 Nov.
summary.en: Authorities say the second phase of the refugee registration programme will begin soon. FMT reported it on Nov 13.

title.bm: Fasa kedua program pendaftaran pelarian akan bermula tidak lama lagi
title.en: Second phase of refugee registration programme to begin soon

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada komuniti pelarian dan perancangan penguatkuasaan.
why.en: Affects refugee communities and enforcement planning.

summary.bm: Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi berkata Kabinet telah meminta nasihat Peguam Negara mengenai cadangan untuk mendedahkan minit tersebut. Umno juga menggesa DAP berunding dan bukan mengugut di tengah kontroversi pengampunan.
summary.en: Communications Minister Fahmi says the Cabinet has asked the Attorney-General for advice on a proposal to declassify the minutes. Umno separately told DAP to talk rather than threaten amid the pardon row.

title.bm: Kabinet dapatkan nasihat Peguam Negara mengenai pengelasan semula minit Lembaga Pengampunan Najib
title.en: Cabinet seeks AG advice on declassifying Najib pardon board minutes

why.bm: Ketelusan keputusan pengampunan penting kepada kestabilan kerajaan perpaduan.
why.en: Transparency over the pardon decision is central to the unity government's stability.

summary.bm: Rayuan akan didengar pada 23 Feb. Tiada rayuan difailkan bagi Nazifuddin.
summary.en: The appeal hearing is fixed for 23 Feb. No appeal will be filed for Nazifuddin.

title.bm: Rayuan LHDN RM1.69 bilion dalam kes muflis Najib ditetapkan 23 Feb
title.en: IRB's RM1.69b appeal in Najib bankruptcy case set for Feb 23

why.bm: Satu lagi peristiwa penting dalam pertikaian cukai yang berlarutan.
why.en: Another milestone in the long-running tax dispute.

summary.bm: Laporan minyak terkini IEA menyatakan bekalan Teluk pulih dan pasaran dijangka kembali kepada lebihan pada suku keempat, walaupun serangan di Hormuz berterusan.
summary.en: The IEA's latest oil report says Gulf supplies are recovering and the market should return to surplus in the fourth quarter, even as Hormuz attacks continue.

title.bm: IEA: Bekalan minyak Teluk pulih, pasaran dijangka kembali lebihan pada S4
title.en: IEA: Gulf oil supplies recovering, market set to return to surplus in Q4

why.bm: Menyokong kos bahan api dan import yang lebih rendah jika risiko perkapalan tidak bertambah buruk.
why.en: Supports easier fuel and import costs if shipping risks do not worsen.

summary.bm: Badan pengawas PBB menggesa Iran membenarkan pemeriksaan semula. Dewan Pakar Iran menyeru semakan keahlian NPT, dan Tehran menolak penghantaran uranium diperkaya 60% ke luar negara.
summary.en: The UN watchdog called on Iran to allow inspections again. Iran's Assembly of Experts has called for a review of NPT membership, and Tehran rejected sending its 60% enriched uranium abroad.

title.bm: IAEA gesa Iran buka semula tapak nuklear untuk pemeriksaan ketika Tehran menimbang keluar NPT
title.en: IAEA urges Iran to reopen nuclear sites to inspection as Tehran weighs NPT exit

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko serangan semula dan gangguan Teluk yang lebih luas sehingga menaikkan harga minyak.
why.en: Raises the risk of renewed strikes and wider Gulf disruption that would lift oil prices.

summary.bm: EU bersetuju lima negara mewakili Eropah dalam rundingan Ukraine manakala Rusia dan Ukraine melaporkan serangan malam dan usaha AS bergelut. Letupan kereta di Rusia membunuh seorang pegawai tentera; Moscow menuding Kyiv.
summary.en: The EU agreed on five countries to represent Europe in Ukraine talks while Russia and Ukraine reported overnight attacks and the US push struggled. Car bombings in Russia killed an officer; Moscow blamed Kyiv.

title.bm: EU pilih lima negara wakili Eropah dalam rundingan damai Ukraine ketika serangan malam berterusan
title.en: EU picks five countries for Ukraine peace talks as overnight attacks continue

why.bm: Menunjukkan kemajuan di Abu Dhabi rapuh dan Eropah mahu bersuara dalam rundingan.
why.en: Shows the Abu Dhabi progress is fragile and Europe wants a seat at the table.

summary.bm: Kedua-dua negara menandatangani perjanjian pertahanan bersama ketika perang Iran dan serangan Houthi ke atas sasaran Saudi terus mengubah keselamatan Teluk.
summary.en: The two countries signed a mutual defence deal as the Iran war and Houthi attacks on Saudi targets continue to reshape Gulf security.

title.bm: Turkiye dan Qatar tandatangani perjanjian pertahanan bersama
title.en: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement

why.bm: Menandakan perubahan pakatan Teluk yang menjejaskan risiko tenaga dan perkapalan.
why.en: Signals shifting Gulf alliances that affect energy and shipping risk.

summary.bm: Tampalan kecemasan membaiki kelemahan tahap tinggi yang dieksploitasi sejak akhir Oktober untuk akses root dan kegigihan. Berasingan, get laluan Check Point yang terdedah diserang melalui PHP2Shell yang memasang perisian pemadam data pada hos VMware ESXi.
summary.en: Emergency hotfixes fix a high-severity flaw exploited since late October for root access and persistence. Separately, vulnerable Check Point gateways were hit with PHP2Shell attacks that dropped data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

title.bm: Check Point tampal sifar-hari get laluan yang dieksploitasi; pemadam ESXi dipasang melalui PHP2Shell
title.en: Check Point patches exploited gateway zero-day; ESXi wiper deployed via PHP2Shell

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: pasang hotfix Check Point sekarang dan semak log get laluan serta ESXi.
why.en: Network admins: apply the Check Point hotfix now and review gateway and ESXi logs.

summary.bm: Fail mesej khas boleh menyebabkan Outlook menyambung ke pelayan penyerang dan membocorkan cincang NTLMv2 pengguna; ia bukan klik-sifar dan Preview Pane bukan vektor. CISA menambahnya ke KEV pada 10 Nov dengan tarikh akhir 24 Nov; binaan dibaiki termasuk 16.0.14334.21048 (LTSC 2021) dan 16.0.17932.21140 (LTSC 2024).
summary.en: A crafted message file can make Outlook connect to an attacker's server and leak the user's NTLMv2 hash; it is not zero-click and the Preview Pane is not a vector. CISA added it to KEV on Nov 10 with a Nov 24 deadline; fixed builds named include 16.0.14334.21048 (LTSC 2021) and 16.0.17932.21140 (LTSC 2024).

title.bm: CISA: Zero-day Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) dieksploit; tampal binaan Office
title.en: CISA: Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) exploited; patch Office builds

why.bm: Kemas kini Office/Microsoft 365 Apps, sahkan nombor binaan dan hadkan NTLM/SMB keluar ke rangkaian tidak dipercayai.
why.en: Update Office/Microsoft 365 Apps, verify build numbers and limit outbound NTLM/SMB to untrusted networks.

summary.bm: Pencerobohan pada vendor AI pihak ketiga Fireworks AI mendedahkan transkrip Notion Insights bagi kurang 1% ruang kerja. Notion dan Fireworks telah menerbitkan nasihat keselamatan.
summary.en: A breach at third-party AI vendor Fireworks AI exposed Notion Insights transcripts for fewer than 1% of workspaces. Notion and Fireworks have published security advisories.

title.bm: Transkrip sembang Notion terdedah akibat serangan siber ke atas vendor AI Fireworks AI
title.en: Notion chat transcripts exposed via cyberattack on AI vendor Fireworks AI

why.bm: Pengguna Notion harus membaca nasihat tersebut dan menyemak data sensitif yang dimasukkan dalam sembang AI.
why.en: Notion users should read the advisory and review what sensitive data was put into AI chat.

summary.bm: Houthi mendakwa menyerang Saudi Aramco di Riyadh, saluran paip Timur-Barat dan Yanbu, manakala gabungan diketuai Saudi berkata ia memintas dron. Brent ditutup pada $95.82, naik 3.3%, ketika empat kapal tangki dilaporkan terkena di dalam dan berhampiran Hormuz.
summary.en: The Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi Aramco in Riyadh, the East-West pipeline and Yanbu, while the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted drones. Brent settled at $95.82, up 3.3%, as four tankers were reported hit in and near Hormuz.

title.bm: Houthi dakwa serang kemudahan Saudi Aramco ketika ketegangan Hormuz meningkat
title.en: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Aramco sites as Hormuz tensions escalate

why.bm: Serangan ke atas laluan eksport Saudi menambah risiko bekalan minyak dan tekanan harga bahan api untuk Malaysia. Dakwaan ini belum disahkan secara bebas.
why.en: Attacks on Saudi export routes add to oil-supply risk and fuel-price pressure for Malaysia. The claims are not independently verified.

summary.bm: Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim berkata kerajaan mengikut proses undang-undang berhubung perintah tahanan rumah Najib dan tidak menentang Yang di-Pertuan Agong, menurut The Star. Isu ini membuka semula jurang PH–BN dua hari sebelum Melaka mengundi.
summary.en: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said the government followed the legal process over Najib's house-arrest order and did not defy the King, according to The Star. The row has reopened the PH–BN divide two days before Melaka votes.

title.bm: Tahanan rumah Najib: Anwar kata kerajaan ikut proses undang-undang dan tidak menderhaka kepada Agong
title.en: Najib house arrest: Anwar says govt followed legal process and did not defy the King

why.bm: Menentukan kestabilan kerajaan perpaduan dan keputusan Melaka pada 14 Nov, isyarat menjelang PRU16.
why.en: Shapes the unity government's stability and the Melaka result on Nov 14, a signal ahead of GE16.

summary.bm: Sebuah bangunan pangsapuri di Brooklyn runtuh ke tapak pembinaan bersebelahan pada Rabu, membunuh lapan orang menurut Datuk Bandar New York, Zohran Mamdani.
summary.en: An apartment building in Brooklyn collapsed into an adjacent construction site on Wednesday, killing eight people, according to NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

title.bm: Lapan maut apabila bangunan pangsapuri Brooklyn runtuh ke tapak pembinaan bersebelahan
title.en: Eight killed as Brooklyn apartment building collapses into neighbouring construction site

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan pembinaan dan pengawasan berhampiran bangunan berpenghuni.
why.en: Raises questions on construction safety and oversight near occupied buildings.

summary.bm: Rundingan diperantarai AS berlangsung hari kedua pada 11 Nov selepas pusingan pertama kira-kira 4.5 jam. Kedua-dua pihak melaporkan sedikit kemajuan, namun Washington menyebut kurang kepercayaan dan perunding Rusia menolak pertukaran wilayah. Penganalisis menyatakan rundingan diketuai AS itu berakhir tanpa kejayaan besar.
summary.en: The US-mediated talks ran a second day on 11 Nov after a first round of about 4.5 hours. Both sides reported some progress, while Washington pointed to a lack of trust and a Russian negotiator rejected territorial swaps. Analysts note the US-led talks ended without a major breakthrough.

title.bm: Rusia dan Ukraine kata ada sedikit kemajuan di rundingan Abu Dhabi, AS sebut kurang kepercayaan
title.en: Russia and Ukraine say some progress made at Abu Dhabi talks, US cites a lack of trust

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga tenaga dan bijirin; kegagalan mengekalkan perbelanjaan keselamatan Eropah dan sekatan.
why.en: A deal would ease pressure on energy and grain prices; failure keeps European security spending and sanctions in play.

summary.bm: Gabungan kumpulan keselamatan dalam talian dan pengguna menyaman lima syarikat AI terkemuka bagi menghentikan pembangunan model baharu kerana risiko 'bencana', menurut AP. Butiran mahkamah dan remedi belum diperoleh.
summary.en: A coalition of online-safety and consumer groups sued five leading AI companies, seeking to halt development of new models over 'catastrophic' risks, per AP. Details of the court and remedy were not available in the extract.

title.bm: Kumpulan advokasi saman Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI dan SpaceX untuk bekukan model AI baharu
title.en: Advocacy groups sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX to freeze new AI models

why.bm: Boleh mempengaruhi peraturan dan jadual AI termaju, termasuk menjelang IPO Anthropic yang dirancang.
why.en: Could shape frontier-AI regulation and timelines, including ahead of Anthropic's planned IPO.

summary.bm: Kod bukti-konsep di GitHub pada Patch Tuesday menyalahgunakan pemacu CLFS Windows (clfs.sys) untuk peningkatan keistimewaan setempat apabila mod pengesahan CLFS ialah 0 atau 1. Belum ada CVE, tampalan atau penggunaan sebenar dilaporkan, dan belum disenaraikan dalam KEV CISA.
summary.en: A proof-of-concept posted on GitHub on Patch Tuesday abuses the Windows CLFS driver (clfs.sys) for local privilege escalation when the CLFS authentication mode is 0 or 1. There is no CVE, patch or in-the-wild use reported yet, and it is not in CISA's KEV list.

title.bm: Eksploit awam 'SignDrop' beri akses SYSTEM pada Windows melalui CLFS; belum ada tampalan
title.en: Public 'SignDrop' exploit gives SYSTEM access on Windows via CLFS; no patch yet

why.bm: Semak nilai mod Authentication CLFS dalam registri, jangan nyahaktifkan mitigasi, dan pantau MSRC untuk tampalan.
why.en: Check the CLFS Authentication Mode registry value, do not disable the mitigation, and watch MSRC for a fix.

summary.bm: Lembaga pengarah mengumumkan peletakan jawatan serta-merta selepas siasatan dan mula mencari CEO tetap; saham jatuh sekitar 7.7% dalam satu tangkapan skrin, melenyapkan ratusan bilion nilai. Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Perbankan Senat AS menyeru Huang dan Setiausaha Perdagangan Lutnick memberi keterangan, dan firma AI China berebut kapasiti cip Nvidia kerana bimbang sekatan AS.
summary.en: The board announced the immediate resignation after an investigation and began a search for a permanent CEO; shares fell about 7.7% in one snapshot, wiping out hundreds of billions in value. A US Senate Banking chair has called for Huang and Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify, and Chinese AI firms are racing to secure Nvidia chip capacity over fears of US curbs.

title.bm: Ketua Eksekutif Nvidia Jensen Huang letak jawatan; CFO Colette Kress dilantik CEO sementara
title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO

why.bm: Nvidia penanda aras cip AI; kejutan ini menjejaskan saham teknologi global serta rantaian bekalan pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia is the AI-chip bellwether; the shock hit global tech stocks and Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor supply chain.

summary.bm: Ribut petir diramal pada hari mengundi Sabtu untuk 28 kerusi, dengan 687,697 pemilih layak. SPR menyasarkan 95% keluar mengundi awal dan menggalakkan pengundi keluar awal.
summary.en: Thunderstorms are forecast for Saturday's polling in 28 seats, with 687,697 eligible voters. The EC targeted 95% turnout at early voting and urges voters to go early.

title.bm: PRN Melaka: ribut petir diramal pada hari mengundi, pengundi digalak keluar awal
title.en: Melaka polls: thunderstorms forecast on polling day, voters urged to go out early

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan dan bawa kelengkapan hujan; keputusan ujian awal hubungan BN-PH.
why.en: Plan your trip and bring rain gear; results are an early test of BN-PH ties.

summary.bm: Ketua Pengarah Pendidikan Tinggi berkata saringan pelajar asing akan diperketat. Langkah ini bertujuan melindungi kualiti dan integriti institusi tempatan.
summary.en: The Higher Education director-general says screening of foreign students will be tightened. The move is aimed at safeguarding the quality and integrity of local institutions.

title.bm: Malaysia ketatkan saringan pelajar antarabangsa untuk lindungi mutu pendidikan tinggi
title.en: Malaysia tightens screening of international students to protect higher-education standards

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada universiti dan bakal pelajar antarabangsa.
why.en: Affects universities and prospective international students.

summary.bm: Pakar bedah menyambung semula tangan seorang anggota polis yang cedera dalam serangan di Kepong. Dalam kes berasingan, empat warga asing direman sehingga 17 Nov atas rompakan dan serangan terhadap anggota polis di Pulau Pinang.
summary.en: Surgeons reattached the hand of a policeman injured in an attack in Kepong. Separately, four foreigners were remanded until Nov 17 over the robbery and assault of a police officer in Penang.

title.bm: Doktor sambung semula tangan polis yang dikapak dalam serangan di Kepong
title.en: Doctors reattach policeman's hand chopped off in Kepong attack

why.bm: Menunjukkan risiko yang dihadapi anggota barisan hadapan.
why.en: Shows the risks frontline officers face.

summary.bm: Peraturan baharu yang dicadangkan membolehkan pengguna mengesahkan status halal ayam yang dibeli. Butiran dilaporkan Malay Mail pada 12 Nov.
summary.en: Proposed new rules would let consumers verify the halal status of chicken they buy. Details were reported by Malay Mail on Nov 12.

title.bm: Pengguna mungkin tidak lama lagi boleh semak status halal ayam di bawah peraturan dicadangkan
title.en: Consumers may soon be able to check chicken's halal status under proposed rules

why.bm: Lebih ketelusan untuk pembeli; peraturan masih dalam cadangan.
why.en: More transparency for shoppers; rules are still proposed.

summary.bm: Kerajaan Pulau Pinang akan berunding pihak berkepentingan mengenai penetapan 18 tahun sebagai umur minimum kahwin bagi orang Islam. Belum ada keputusan diumumkan.
summary.en: The Penang government will consult stakeholders on setting 18 as the minimum Muslim marriage age. No decision has been announced.

title.bm: Pulau Pinang akan berunding pihak berkepentingan untuk naikkan umur kahwin Muslim kepada 18
title.en: Penang to consult stakeholders on raising Muslim marriage age to 18

why.bm: Berkaitan perlindungan kanak-kanak dan pembaharuan undang-undang keluarga.
why.en: Relevant to child-protection and family-law reform.

summary.bm: Beijing mengecam penggunaan dakwaan "pengintipan" Nvidia oleh AS untuk mempertahankan sekatan teknologi, merumitkan pertemuan Xi-Trump minggu depan. Gencatan setahun itu tamat pada Januari. Senator Demokrat meminta rekod eksport Nvidia dipelihara.
summary.en: Beijing denounced US use of Nvidia "spying" claims to defend tech curbs, complicating next week's Xi-Trump meeting. The year-long truce expires in January. Democratic senators asked the administration to preserve Nvidia export records.

title.bm: Pertikaian Nvidia menguji gencatan dagang AS-China menjelang kunjungan Trump ke Xi minggu depan
title.en: Nvidia row tests US-China trade truce as Xi set to welcome Trump next week

why.bm: Kegagalan rundingan boleh menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip dan sektor semikonduktor Malaysia yang bergantung pada eksport.
why.en: A breakdown would hit chip supply chains and Malaysia's export-driven semiconductor sector.

summary.bm: Pembaikan meliputi NetScaler ADC, Gateway dan Console. CVE kritikal termasuk CVE-2026-120868, CVE-2026-107407 dan CVE-2026-107408 (masing-masing CVSS 9.3).
summary.en: Fixes cover NetScaler ADC, Gateway and Console. Critical CVEs listed include CVE-2026-120868, CVE-2026-107407 and CVE-2026-107408 (each CVSS 9.3).

title.bm: Citrix tampal 12 kelemahan NetScaler dan Secure Access Client, termasuk pintasan pengesahan
title.en: Citrix patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client flaws, incl. authentication bypass

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: naik taraf NetScaler ke binaan yang dibaiki dan hadkan akses pengurusan.
why.en: Network admins: upgrade NetScaler to the fixed builds and restrict management access.

summary.bm: Selepas meletak jawatan Menteri Pengangkutan pada 10 Nov, Anthony Loke berkata hanya Perdana Menteri boleh menasihatkan pembubaran dan Anwar masih ada kira-kira setahun tempoh mandat. Beliau menjawab gesaan Pengerusi BN Ahmad Zahid Hamidi supaya PRU diadakan awal; Melaka mengundi Sabtu ini. Loke berkata pada 11 Nov peletakan jawatannya sebagai menteri pengangkutan muktamad dan DAP belum membincangkan pengganti, yang menjadi keputusan PM.
summary.en: After resigning as transport minister on Nov 10, DAP's Anthony Loke said only the PM can advise dissolution and Anwar has about a year left in his mandate. He was responding to BN chairman Ahmad Zahid Hamidi's call for an early general election; Melaka votes on Saturday. Loke said on 11 Nov his resignation as transport minister is final and DAP has not discussed a successor, which is the PM's decision.

title.bm: Loke gesa BN keluar kerajaan perpaduan jika tidak bersetuju dengan PM, tolak gesaan PRU awal
title.en: Loke tells BN to quit the unity govt if it disagrees with Anwar, rejecting early-election calls

why.bm: Ketegangan dalam kerajaan perpaduan menjelang PRN Melaka boleh mempengaruhi masa PRU16 dan kestabilan dasar.
why.en: Strains within the unity government ahead of the Melaka poll could shape GE16 timing and policy stability.

summary.bm: Semasa melancarkan Malaysia Economic Monitor Oktober 2026, Bank Dunia menjangkakan prospek positif 2H 2026 disokong pekerjaan, sokongan fiskal bersasar dan pelaburan. Ia menyenaraikan konflik geopolitik, ketegangan perdagangan dan permintaan global lemah sebagai risiko serta menggesa ruang fiskal dibina semula.
summary.en: Launching the October 2026 Malaysia Economic Monitor, the World Bank sees a positive 2H 2026 outlook backed by jobs, targeted fiscal support and investment. It flags geopolitical conflict, trade tensions and weaker global demand as risks and urges rebuilding fiscal space.

title.bm: Bank Dunia: Ekonomi Malaysia berdaya tahan, tetapi reformasi struktur 'bukan pilihan'
title.en: World Bank: Malaysia's economy resilient, but structural reforms 'not optional'

why.bm: Menunjukkan arah tekanan dasar ketika Malaysia menghampiri status berpendapatan tinggi.
why.en: Signals where policy pressure is headed as Malaysia nears high-income status.

summary.bm: S-1 terkini Anthropic menawarkan 825 juta saham Kelas A pada $70–$78, menjana kira-kira $57.75 bilion–$64.35 bilion kasar dengan nilai tersirat sehingga $1.404 trilion (berbanding $965 bilion pada Mei). Dagangan di Nasdaq dijangka sekitar 19 Nov di bawah simbol ANT; penempatan persendirian $26 bilion berasingan ditawarkan kepada rakan cip dan awan termasuk Nvidia, Google dan Microsoft. Tawaran runcit Australia dibuka 11 Nov dan ditutup 17 Nov, menurut AI Weekly. Bloomberg melaporkan tawaran itu menyasarkan kira-kira $64.4 bilion, dengan 20% dilaporkan diperuntukkan kepada pelabur runcit.
summary.en: Anthropic's updated S-1 offers 825 million Class A shares at $70–$78, raising roughly $57.75bn–$64.35bn gross and implying a valuation of up to $1.404tn (versus $965bn in May). Trading is expected on Nasdaq around Nov 19 under the ticker ANT; a separate $26bn private placement goes to chip and cloud partners including Nvidia, Google and Microsoft. An Australian retail offer opened 11 Nov and closes 17 Nov, per AI Weekly. Bloomberg reports the offering targets about $64.4bn, with 20% reportedly reserved for retail investors.

title.bm: Anthropic menetapkan julat harga IPO $70–$78 sesaham menjelang pendebutan di Nasdaq
title.en: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70–$78 a share ahead of Nasdaq debut

why.bm: Terma kini dalam pemfailan; salah satu penyenaraian teknologi terbesar dan petunjuk selera pasaran terhadap sektor AI.
why.en: Terms are now in the filing; one of the largest tech listings ever and a gauge of AI-sector appetite.

summary.bm: The Hacker News melaporkan Google mengeluarkan kemas kini keselamatan Chrome bagi satu lagi kelemahan sifar-hari yang dieksploitasi, yang kelapan tahun ini.
summary.en: The Hacker News reports Google has shipped a Chrome security update for another zero-day exploited in the wild, the eighth this year.

title.bm: Google keluarkan kemas kini Chrome bagi kelemahan sifar-hari kelapan yang dieksploitasi pada 2026
title.en: Google issues Chrome update for the eighth actively exploited zero-day of 2026

why.bm: Kemas kini Chrome dan pelayar Chromium lain (Edge) ke versi terkini dan mulakan semula.
why.en: Update Chrome and other Chromium browsers (Edge) to the latest version and restart.

summary.bm: Ketua Polis Negara berkata Jabatan Penjara, bukan polis, bertanggungjawab ke atas keselamatan di kediaman Najib semasa tahanan rumah.
summary.en: The Inspector-General of Police says the Prisons Department, not police, is responsible for security at Najib's residence during house arrest.

title.bm: KPN: Jabatan Penjara bertanggungjawab ke atas keselamatan rumah Najib
title.en: IGP says Prisons Dept is responsible for Najib's home security

why.bm: Menjelaskan agensi yang mengendalikan pengaturan tahanan rumah.
why.en: Clarifies who handles the house-arrest arrangement.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan rombakan kecil dijangka selepas peletakan jawatan Loke, manakala Puad berkata Zahid bimbang kehilangan jawatan menteri. Mat Sabu turut menyeru tahanan rumah dibuka kepada semua banduan.
summary.en: FMT reports a minor reshuffle is expected after Loke's resignation, while Puad says Zahid is wary of losing his ministerial post. Mat Sabu also called for house arrest to be made available to all convicts.

title.bm: Rombakan kecil Kabinet jawatan DAP dijangka selepas Loke keluar
title.en: Minor Cabinet reshuffle of DAP posts expected after Loke's exit

why.bm: Menunjukkan bagaimana keputusan Najib membentuk semula kerajaan.
why.en: Shows how the Najib ruling is reshaping the government.

summary.bm: Pertak, Siling dan Batang Kali ialah kawasan paling berisiko bagi air naik mendadak, selepas kejadian di Pertak meragut lima nyawa awal minggu ini.
summary.en: Pertak, Siling and Batang Kali are the top hotspots for sudden water surges, after the Pertak surge left five dead earlier this week.

title.bm: Bomba amaran orang ramai jauhi 14 sungai dan air terjun di Hulu Selangor
title.en: Fire Dept warns public to stay away from 14 Hulu Selangor rivers and waterfalls

why.bm: Elakkan sungai dan air terjun ketika hujan lebat.
why.en: Avoid rivers and waterfalls during heavy rain.

summary.bm: Kerajaan akan memberi subsidi RM15 juta sebulan apabila kos minyak sawit meningkat, menurut Malay Mail.
summary.en: The government will provide a RM15 million monthly subsidy as palm oil costs rise, per Malay Mail.

title.bm: Kerajaan beri subsidi RM15 juta sebulan apabila kos minyak sawit meningkat
title.en: Govt steps in with RM15m monthly subsidy as palm oil costs rise

why.bm: Bertujuan meredakan harga minyak masak bagi pengguna.
why.en: Aims to cushion cooking-oil prices for consumers.

summary.bm: Amaran tahap 'Waspada' meliputi tujuh daerah Kelantan, empat di Terengganu serta Kudat, Pitas dan Paitan di Sabah untuk 24 jam akan datang susulan lonjakan monsun. Semak myCuaca atau talian 1-300-22-1638.
summary.en: An 'Alert'-level warning covers seven Kelantan districts, four in Terengganu and Kudat, Pitas and Paitan in Sabah for the next 24 hours as a monsoon surge arrives. Check myCuaca or hotline 1-300-22-1638.

title.bm: MetMalaysia keluarkan amaran hujan berterusan untuk Kelantan, Terengganu dan Sabah hingga Khamis
title.en: MetMalaysia continuous-rain alert for Kelantan, Terengganu and Sabah until Thursday

why.bm: Penduduk perlu bersedia menghadapi kemungkinan banjir.
why.en: Residents should prepare for possible floods.

summary.bm: Agensi Pengurusan Bencana Negara berkata 102,000 anggota dikerahkan bagi musim monsun.
summary.en: The National Disaster Management Agency says 102,000 personnel are being deployed for the monsoon season.

title.bm: Nadma kerah 102,000 anggota menjelang Monsun Timur Laut 2026/2027
title.en: Nadma deploys 102,000 personnel ahead of the 2026/2027 northeast monsoon

why.bm: Sediakan kit kecemasan dan ikuti amaran banjir rasmi.
why.en: Prepare an emergency kit and follow official flood warnings.

summary.bm: CPI AS Oktober naik 0.4% bulan ke bulan berbanding jangkaan 0.3%, dengan CPI teras naik 0.3% berbanding ramalan 0.2%. Gabenor Fed Waller menyokong sekurang-kurangnya kenaikan suku mata peratusan pada Disember, dan S&P 500 didagangkan kira-kira 0.9% lebih rendah serta Nasdaq sekitar 1% lebih rendah pada Selasa.
summary.en: US October CPI rose 0.4% month on month against 0.3% expected, with core CPI up 0.3% versus 0.2% forecast. Fed Governor Waller backs at least a quarter-point hike in December, and the S&P 500 traded about 0.9% lower and the Nasdaq about 1% lower on Tuesday.

title.bm: Data inflasi AS yang panas meningkatkan jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed dan menekan Wall Street
title.en: Hot US inflation data lifts Fed rate-hike bets and hits Wall Street

why.bm: Kadar AS lebih tinggi lebih lama boleh menekan ringgit, Bursa dan kos import Malaysia.
why.en: Higher-for-longer US rates can pressure the ringgit, Bursa and Malaysian import costs.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan lebihan dagangan China melonjak melepasi AS$1 trilion, didorong eksport berkaitan AI.
summary.en: FMT reports China's trade surplus surged past US$1tn, powered by AI-related exports.

title.bm: Lebihan dagangan China melepasi AS$1 trilion apabila ledakan AI menaikkan eksport
title.en: China's trade surplus passes US$1 trillion as AI boom lifts exports

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko ketegangan dagangan menjelang sidang APEC dan memberi kesan kepada eksport elektronik Malaysia.
why.en: Raises trade-tension risk ahead of the APEC summit and affects Malaysia's electronics exports.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Suite beta ini menyasarkan pekerja pengetahuan bukan pengaturcara, dengan Meetings (Team/Enterprise, bermula Google Meet), Whiteboards dan Sheets, serta Claude Data untuk pelan berbayar; penyambung kini meliputi 9,000+ aplikasi. Fortune melaporkan saham Microsoft jatuh lebih 2% dan roadshow IPO bermula hari sama.
summary.en: The beta suite targets non-coding knowledge workers, with Meetings (Team/Enterprise, Google Meet first), Whiteboards and Sheets, and Claude Data on paid plans; connectors now cover 9,000+ apps. Fortune says Microsoft shares fell over 2% and the IPO roadshow began the same day.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Meetings, Whiteboards, Sheets dan Data sebagai suite pejabat sebelum IPO
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings, Whiteboards, Sheets and Data as an office suite before its IPO

why.bm: Ia menolak Claude ke wilayah pejabat Microsoft dan Google.
why.en: It pushes Claude into Microsoft and Google's office territory.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Carbon tiba kepada pelanggan AI Ultra dengan harga API pengenalan $2/$10 setiap sejuta token hingga 30 Nov. Google juga menerbitkan dua TPU generasi kelapan baharu pada 9 Nov.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Carbon reached AI Ultra subscribers with introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens through Nov 30. Google also published two new eighth-generation TPUs on Nov 9.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Carbon untuk AI Ultra dan perkenal TPU 8tx serta 8i Max
title.en: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to AI Ultra and unveils TPU 8tx and 8i Max

why.bm: Akses model terkini lebih murah dan persaingan cip AI meningkat.
why.en: Cheaper frontier access and more AI chip competition.

summary.bm: Kelemahan CVSS 8.1 ini menjejaskan OpenSSH pada musl dengan PAM dimatikan, termasuk konfigurasi lalai Alpine, dan membolehkan penyerang log masuk akaun tanpa kata laluan sah. Ia dibaiki dalam OpenSSH 10.6p2; percubaan eksploit pertama berlaku kurang sembilan jam selepas penerbitan. CISA menambahnya ke katalog KEV pada 9 Nov bersama kelemahan GPUStack, FreeSWITCH dan IBM Aspera Faspex; tarikh akhir persekutuan ialah 12 Nov.
summary.en: The CVSS 8.1 flaw affects OpenSSH on musl with PAM disabled, including Alpine's default, and lets attackers log into accounts with no usable password. It is fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2; a first exploit attempt came under nine hours after publication. CISA added it to its KEV catalog on Nov 9 with GPUStack, FreeSWITCH and IBM Aspera Faspex flaws; federal deadline is Nov 12.

title.bm: Kelemahan OpenSSH 'SSHole' CVE-2026-123158 dieksploitasi dalam beberapa jam
title.en: OpenSSH 'SSHole' flaw CVE-2026-123158 exploited within hours of disclosure

why.bm: Tampal hos SSH Alpine/musl ke 10.6p2 atau aktifkan PAM.
why.en: Patch Alpine/musl SSH hosts to 10.6p2 or enable PAM.

summary.bm: Reuters: Brent turun 1.5% kepada $96.91 dan WTI 1% kepada $89.85 pada 9 Nov selepas Trump mengisyaratkan sikap berhati-hati terhadap Iran, walaupun kedua-dua pihak melaporkan kapal diserang berhampiran Hormuz. Brent jatuh 16% minggu sebelumnya, penurunan mingguan paling tajam sejak awal Covid; penganalisis menyebut sokongan sekitar $93 dan lebihan bekalan (JPMorgan: 1.4 juta tong sehari bagi Oktober).
summary.en: Reuters: Brent fell 1.5% to $96.91 and WTI 1% to $89.85 on Nov 9 after Trump signalled restraint on Iran, even as both sides reported shipping hit near Hormuz. Brent fell 16% the previous week, its steepest weekly drop since the start of Covid; analysts cite support near $93 and a supply surplus (JPMorgan: 1.4m bpd in October).

title.bm: Brent tutup minggu hampir $98 selepas penurunan mingguan terbesar sejak 2020, tetapi serangan Hormuz kekalkan turun naik
title.en: Brent ends the week near $98 after its biggest weekly fall since 2020, but Hormuz attacks keep it volatile

summary.bm: Seorang pesara kerugian RM179,490 selepas penipu menyamar polis mendakwa beliau terlibat pengubahan wang haram. Polis menggesa orang ramai mengesahkan panggilan sebegini.
summary.en: A retiree lost RM179,490 after scammers posing as police claimed he was linked to money laundering. Police urge the public to verify such calls.

title.bm: Penipu menyamar polis tipu pesara RM179,490 dalam sindiket pengubahan wang haram
title.en: Fake cops cheat retiree of RM179,490 in money-laundering scam

why.bm: Penipuan menyamar pihak berkuasa masih kerap berlaku; jangan pindahkan wang atas arahan panggilan telefon.
why.en: Impersonation scams remain a top fraud type; never transfer money on a phone call's demand.

summary.bm: Beberapa media melaporkan pemilik Pixel masih menunggu kemas kini November 2026. Android Authority mencadangkan Android 17 QPR2 mungkin sebabnya.
summary.en: Several outlets report Pixel owners are still waiting for the November 2026 update. Android Authority suggests Android 17 QPR2 may be the reason.

title.bm: Kemas kini Pixel November Google masih belum tiba; Android 17 QPR2 mungkin puncanya
title.en: Google's November Pixel update still missing; Android 17 QPR2 may explain delay

why.bm: Pengguna Pixel perlu pantau tampalan itu.
why.en: Pixel users should watch for the patch.

summary.bm: Dalam satu daripada tiga pertikaian, tribunal mengawardkan RM2,000 dengan faedah 8% dan mendapati Auto Accept serta Fast Cancel melanggar Akta Pekerja Gig 2025. Dalam kes lain, penyahaktifan seorang pemandu atas salah laku disahkan.
summary.en: In one of three disputes the tribunal awarded RM2,000 with 8% interest and found Auto Accept and Fast Cancel breached the Gig Workers Act 2025. In another it upheld a driver's deactivation over misconduct.

title.bm: Tribunal Pekerja Gig putuskan auto-accept GrabCar langgar hak pemandu
title.en: Gig Workers Tribunal rules GrabCar's auto-accept breaches drivers' rights

why.bm: Ujian awal undang-undang pekerja gig baharu bagi pemandu e-hailing.
why.en: An early test of the new gig-worker law for e-hailing drivers.

summary.bm: QuickCheck The Star menilai dakwaan itu palsu. Mohamad Sabu berkata kerajaan belum sampai ke tahap itu dan menasihati orang ramai tidak membeli panik, dengan stok beras cukup enam bulan dan bekalan ikan beku terjamin lapan bulan; Fomca sebelum ini menyarankan pengguna menyimpan bekalan 72 jam sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga.
summary.en: The Star's QuickCheck rates the claim false. Mohamad Sabu said the government has not reached that stage and advised against panic buying, saying rice stocks last six months and frozen fish supply is assured for eight months; Fomca had advised consumers to keep 72 hours of supplies as a precaution.

title.bm: QuickCheck: tiada arahan kerajaan simpan stok makanan tiga hari
title.en: QuickCheck: no government order to stockpile three days of food

why.bm: Elak membeli panik dan semak dakwaan dengan sumber rasmi.
why.en: Avoid panic buying and check claims against official sources.

summary.en: The iPad mini with OLED and A20 Pro, M6 iMac and M6 14-inch MacBook Pro plus OLED touchscreen 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros launched Nov 6. MacTech also reports Apple's fourth-quarter revenue rose 12%.

title.bm: Lima produk baharu Apple dijual; HomeView dan Apple TV 4K menyusul 13 Nov
title.en: Apple's five new products go on sale; HomeView and Apple TV 4K follow on Nov 13

why.bm: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dihantar dalam dua hingga tiga minggu.
why.en: Touchscreen MacBook Pros ship in two to three weeks.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: ChAdOx1 Oxford/Serum Institute dan mRNA-1469 Moderna akan menyertai ujian Tumaini yang bermula 23 Okt di Bunia dengan vaksinasi cincin. WHO merekodkan lebih 10,500 kes dan 5,126 kematian setakat 1 Nov.
summary.en: Oxford/Serum Institute ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469 will join the Tumaini trial, which began Oct 23 in Bunia with ring vaccination. WHO counted over 10,500 cases and 5,126 deaths as of Nov 1.

title.bm: WHO tambah dua calon vaksin khusus Bundibugyo ke ujian Ebola DRC
title.en: WHO adds two Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidates to DRC Ebola trial

why.bm: Pelancong ke kawasan terjejas patut mengikut nasihat KKM dan WHO.
why.en: Travellers to affected areas should follow KKM and WHO advisories.

summary.bm: ProductNation melaporkan pra-pesanan dibuka di kedai Apple Malaysia, dengan ketersediaan dari 6 Nov. iPad mini OLED bermula RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, tambah RM700 untuk selular), dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M5 Pro skrin sentuh dengan 24GB dan 1TB bermula RM11,999.
summary.en: ProductNation reports pre-orders are open on Apple's Malaysian store, with availability from Nov 6. The OLED iPad mini starts at RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, RM700 more for cellular), and the touchscreen 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB and 1TB starts at RM11,999.

title.bm: Harga Malaysia ditetapkan: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dari RM11,999, iPad mini dari RM2,999, dihantar 6 Nov
title.en: Malaysia prices set: touchscreen MacBook Pro from RM11,999, iPad mini from RM2,999, shipping Nov 6

why.bm: Ini menjawab persoalan harga Malaysia sebelum pelancaran Jumaat.
why.en: This answers the open Malaysian pricing question before Friday's launch.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Pembangun kini boleh menetapkan mesej pengekalan dalam App Store Connect yang muncul dalam aliran pembatalan, dengan teks, imej atau tawaran khas. API Retention Messaging yang berasingan, tersedia atas permintaan, membolehkan aplikasi memilih mesej bagi setiap pelanggan.
summary.en: Developers can now set retention messages in App Store Connect that appear in the cancellation flow, with text, images or a special offer. A separate Retention Messaging API, available by request, lets apps choose messages per subscriber.

title.bm: App Store benarkan pembangun papar tawaran pengekalan apabila pelanggan cuba membatalkan langganan
title.en: App Store lets developers show retention offers when subscribers try to cancel

why.bm: Jangkakan tawaran diskaun apabila anda membatalkan langganan aplikasi.
why.en: Expect discount offers when you cancel an app subscription.

summary.bm: Kumpulan Threat Intelligence Google dan polis Jepun mengganggu pelayan kawalan dan mengharamkan pembuat Videostrong daripada menghasilkan peranti Android bertauliah. Penutupan itu tidak membersihkan kotak yang dijangkiti, dan Google berkata ia mungkin memutuskan sekurang-kurangnya 10 juta lagi peranti yang terjejas. NACSA berkata malware XCPE ditanam dalam peranti semasa pembuatan.
summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and Japan's police disrupted the command servers and banned maker Videostrong from making certified Android devices. The takedown does not clean infected boxes, and Google says it may cut off at least 10 million more compromised devices. NACSA says the XCPE malware was planted in devices during manufacture.

title.bm: Google ganggu botnet XCPE yang menjangkiti lebih 1.3 juta kotak Android TV
title.en: Google disrupts XCPE botnet that infected over 1.3 million Android TV boxes

why.bm: Kotak Android TV murah tanpa jenama biasa di Malaysia; semak kotak anda dan pertimbangkan menggantinya jika terjejas.
why.en: Cheap unbranded Android TV boxes are common in Malaysia; check yours and consider replacing it if it is affected.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata kemas kini November membaiki lebih 200 kelemahan; The Hacker News menyebut CVE-2026-58868, kelemahan kritikal yang membolehkan pelaksanaan kod jauh tanpa interaksi pengguna pada Android 14 hingga 17.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says the November updates fix over 200 vulnerabilities; The Hacker News notes CVE-2026-58868, a critical flaw allowing remote code execution without user interaction on Android 14 to 17.

title.bm: Kemas kini Android November tampal 200+ kelemahan, termasuk RCE kritikal CVE-2026-58868
title.en: Android November updates patch 200+ flaws, including critical RCE CVE-2026-58868

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini keselamatan Android terkini sebaik sahaja tersedia pada telefon anda.
why.en: Install the latest Android security update as soon as it reaches your phone.

summary.bm: Google berkata tambahan AS$15 bilion akan mengembangkan pusat datanya di Malaysia dalam dua tahun dan menjangka 37,000 pekerjaan. Anwar mengalu-alukan pelaburan itu.
summary.en: Google says the extra US$15 billion will expand its Malaysian data centre footprint over two years and projects 37,000 jobs. Anwar hailed the investment.

title.bm: Google tambah komitmen AS$15 bilion untuk pusat data Malaysia dalam tempoh dua tahun
title.en: Google commits another US$15bn to Malaysian data centres over two years

why.bm: Rangsangan besar kepada ekosistem pusat data dan awan serta pekerjaan teknologi di Malaysia.
why.en: A big boost for Malaysia's data-centre and cloud ecosystem and tech jobs.

summary.bm: Diumumkan di AWS Cloud and AI Day di Kuala Lumpur, ia merangkumi perintis GovHub untuk 500 pembangun meningkat kepada 4,000 menjelang 2028 dan Amazon Quick untuk 445,000 pegawai. PKS mendapat akses percuma Quick dan Kiro selama enam bulan selepas penilaian, selaras komitmen AWS sebanyak RM29.2 bilion di Malaysia.
summary.en: Announced at AWS Cloud and AI Day in Kuala Lumpur, it includes a GovHub pilot for 500 developers rising to 4,000 by 2028 and Amazon Quick for 445,000 officers. SMEs get six months of free Quick and Kiro access after an assessment, building on AWS's RM29.2 billion Malaysian commitment.

title.bm: AWS lancar Semarak AI Malaysia, tawar alat AI kepada 445,000 pegawai kerajaan dan 10,000 PKS menjelang 2028
title.en: AWS launches Semarak AI Malaysia, offering AI tools to 445,000 government officers and 10,000 SMEs by 2028

why.bm: Ia membawa alat AI percuma kepada PKS dan perkhidmatan awam Malaysia, bukan sekadar perbelanjaan pusat data.
why.en: It brings free AI tooling to Malaysian SMEs and the civil service, not just data-centre spending.
